name: RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell llama.cpp: Qwen3 32B decode at 4k (Hardware Corner)
methodology: Hardware Corner RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell LLM benchmark page (updated March 2026). Same lab method as their RTX 5090 llama-bench series already ingested: llama.cpp llama-bench, Ubuntu 24.04, CUDA 12.8, Q4_K / Q4_K_XL GGUF (gpt-oss 20B labeled MXFP4 on the page). Context depth 4k. Per-request, batch size 1, NOT aggregate across concurrent requests. The page does not print the llama.cpp commit or the exact prompt/output lengths for this card; the sibling 5090 series in this repo used build 466c1911 with -fa 1 -ngl 99, prompt 1024/2048, output 128. That protocol is the likely one and is NOT asserted as measured on this card.
notes: Transcribed from the March 2026 Hardware Corner table for the 48 GB RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell. The 72 GB SKU has no public row on this page and is a separate accelerator id. Page headline 84.3 t/s generation and 3,064 t/s prompt processing for 14B 4-bit at 16k matches the 14B 16k cells. 48 GB GDDR7; Llama 3.3 70B Q4_K reported to fit fully in VRAM.
